answer: The farm's advantage is speed; take speed away and it has nothing. Voter registration tenure with electoral commission attestation takes it away with a registration held for years in the electoral roll. The juniper of the mechanism is accrual: the record grows a little each year and cannot be rushed, so a hundred accounts need a hundred slow histories running in parallel for a decade. The summit in every one of those histories is a human being present in person, signing, paying, and being seen. The gale that ends it is the verifier counting the years on the page.
